english_classification.chapter_title: Concerning the Light Mind and the Apostles and the Saints
english_classification.chapter_note: This long chapter has a clearly substratic first two-thirds (¶11-42) containing the quintessential body-cosmos correspondence and the five-fold soul-body binding/loosing formula — among the most important substrate teachings in the corpus. The macrocosm-as-human-body mapping (¶11-12) and the soul-binding formula (¶35, reversed in ¶38) are classic correspondential substrate: both sides of every mapping stay within the cosmic system. The five watch-districts of the Living Spirit's sons (¶19-28) form a complete cosmological architecture. The chapter shows clear editorial fatigue: substrate dominates ¶11-43, institutional overlay increases in the progressive-sin sequence (¶44-50), and the apostolate section (¶59-66) is entirely institutional. The editorial_bridge material in ¶36 (idol worship) is diagnostic — the five-fold overlay teaching pivots mid-paragraph to contemporary religious polemic. The progressive sin-attack sequence (¶43-50) preserves substrate structure (the five-fold inward progression from consideration to mind) but is heavily overlaid with institutional description of church community responses.
